All images below are CC0 or Public Domain Mark. No attribution is legally
required; it is recorded here so the provenance is auditable and so nothing
copyrighted ever enters the asset pipeline by accident.

Sourced via the Openverse API (`license=cc0,pdm`), centre-cropped to 3:2 and
re-encoded to WebP at two widths (960 / 1440).
